correctness.rationale: The frozen proof is reconstructed from group presentation G_k=(F_2)^k ⋊ LB_2, LB_2=Z*C_2, and the fact both ring-motion generators act as the same transposition J on each rank-2 abelianization. For any coefficient module W with common involution J_W, Mayer--Vietoris for Z*C_2 yields H_0(B;W)=W_+ and 0→W_+→H_1(B;W)→W_-→0, with H_p=0 for p>=2 rationally. The LHS spectral sequence has columns p=0,1 only and collapses without differentials. Its trace on H_1 is trace on W; on H_0 it is half the ordinary and J-twisted traces. Permutation-stable subsets are unions of cycles; Koszul signs (-1)^(j-1) produce F, while J^j has trace 0 for odd j and 2 for even j, producing E. Checked directly k=0 gives 1+t, k=2 identity gives (1,3,6,4), transposition yields character polynomial 1+t-2t²-2t³, and reviewed full standalone exact enumeration design for 874 permutations through k=6. This is rational group homology, not H_*(M_{2,k}) or integral torsion.
